description: Validate a Mexican CURP: format, birth date, sex, state code, internal consonants and RENAPO check digit. Offline; does not query RENAPO. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/mx/curp.

value.description: CURP (18 chars). Spaces, dashes and lowercase are normalized.

name: mx_curp
title: Validate Mexican CURP (RENAPO)
